description: Defines an abstract class 'MappingStrategies' that manages a collection of JSON-parsable mapping strategies for cluster communication, including loading strategies via configuration and actor system integration.

classes.name: MappingStrategies
classes.description: An immutable abstract class extending Map, managing cluster mapping strategies associated with string keys, with capabilities to load strategies from configuration.

methods.name: loadMappingStrategies
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a MappingStrategies implementation based on configuration within the provided ActorSystem.

methods.name: getMappingStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the mapping strategy associated with a given key.
